excluded.name: T CrB
excluded.reason: T CrB, a recurrent nova. The catalogue's V 2.0 (code H, the original Harvard magnitude) is its 1866 outburst peak; between outbursts it sits near V 10, far below the naked-eye limit, so drawing it as a second-magnitude star would put a star in Corona Borealis that is not there.
